top_signals.summary: UK borrowing costs have hit their highest level since the financial crisis as gilts were swept up in a mass rout across global bond markets.  The UK government is set to pay a higher rate on debt interest as 10-year gilt yields, the benchmark for borrowing costs, were up by as much as 15 basis [...]
